title: FACTION MEMORY PASS RETURN PATH
description: The patch turns a design concern into a calendar decision and calls that production maturity. NPCs now remember a handful of faction choices and respond with small grudges instead of universal politeness. Declining the shop now returns players to a smaller, friendlier offer instead of the game.
consequence: The world developed a memory just large enough to be inconvenient. The back button became a polite hallway with prices.

title: FACTION MEMORY PASS ESCAPE ROUTE
description: The feature asks players to perform progress for each other before asking whether the progress is good. NPCs now remember a handful of faction choices and respond with small grudges instead of universal politeness. Shop exits now send players back to the last activity without a second offer or educational delay.
consequence: The world developed a memory just large enough to be inconvenient. The funnel lost a wall and several people escaped through it.

title: NARRATIVE COMPRESSION SPRINT RETURN PATH
description: The release frames the feature as seasonal structure, while burying the real priority in the reward cadence. Side stories now resolve faster so players can return to reward tracks before the mood becomes measurable. Declining the shop now returns players to a smaller, friendlier offer instead of the game.
consequence: The kingdom's grief was preserved as a tooltip and two currencies. The back button became a polite hallway with prices.
